sections.text_helper: Section 55.3.10 "Debug mode" in chapter 55 (Basic timers (TIM6/TIM7/TIM18)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2751.
sections.section_content:
When the microcontroller enters debug mode (Cortex®-M55 core halted), the TIMx counter
can either continue to work normally or be stopped.
The behavior in debug mode can be programmed with a dedicated configuration bit per
timer in the Debug support (DBG) module.
For more details, refer to section Debug support (DBG).
